splitGate.label: Split Gate
splitGate.description: Two surfaces separate to clear the center; they can later become curtains, doors, leaves, clouds or glass.

irisBloom.label: Iris Bloom
irisBloom.description: Concentric layers bloom from the center, ready to become a flower, sun, moon, drum, lace or halo.

depthPortal.label: Depth Portal
depthPortal.description: Layered planes move through depth into a reveal surface, suited to arches, forests, cinema, cities or galaxies.

ribbonSweep.label: Ribbon Sweep
ribbonSweep.description: One curved band crosses and clears the frame; it can become silk, ink, a wave, smoke, light or film.

css.label: CSS Keyframes
css.description: The lightest baseline: small, maintainable and friendly to the browser compositor.

waapi.label: Web Animations API
waapi.description: Native DOM timelines without updating React on every animation frame.

gsap.label: GSAP
gsap.description: A choreography-rich timeline used as the enhanced reference for more complex beats.

canvas.label: Canvas 2D
canvas.description: All geometry is drawn into one surface with a finite RAF loop and capped pixel density.

webgl.label: R3F / WebGL
webgl.description: Basic meshes move through depth with demand rendering and no idle render loop.

flowDemoLab.guardrailsBody: Every version uses the same geometric actors, duration and destination. This lab evaluates motion direction, not invitation content.
flowDemoLab.guardrailTransform: DOM engines animate transform and opacity only—no blur, shadow or layout changes.
flowDemoLab.guardrailFinite: Every timeline and RAF loop stops completely after handoff.
flowDemoLab.guardrailDpr: Canvas and WebGL use DPR 1 on mobile and at most 1.25 on desktop.
flowDemoLab.compareWarning: Compare is for visual review only; it is not a valid FPS benchmark.

faq.heading: Quick answers about online wedding invitations
faq.q1Q: What is an online wedding invitation?
faq.q1A: A digital invitation page that replaces paper invites, with photos, music, a map, guest wishes and RSVP, shared through one personal link.
faq.q2Q: Does creating an online invitation take a lot of time?
faq.q2A: No. Pick a template and fill in your details, and you can finish an invitation in about 10 minutes.
faq.q3Q: Do I need design or coding skills?
faq.q3A: Not at all. Everything is visual, just enter your content and the invitation comes together on its own.
faq.q4Q: What should I prepare before creating an invitation?
faq.q4A: The couple's names, the ceremony date and time, the venue and a few wedding photos are enough to get started.
faq.q5Q: Can the invitation include photos, music, a map and RSVP?
faq.q5A: Yes. You can add a photo album, background music, a navigation map and an RSVP form.
faq.q6Q: Can I edit the content after publishing?
faq.q6A: Yes. Content updates instantly on the same link, with no need to resend it to guests.
faq.q7Q: How many guests can I send the invitation to?
faq.q7A: There is no limit on guests. You can create a personal link for each guest or share one link.
faq.q8Q: How do guests receive and view the invitation?
faq.q8A: Guests just open the link you send on their phone or computer, with no install or login required.
faq.q9Q: Does the invitation display well on phones and computers?
faq.q9A: Yes. The invitation adapts automatically to look great on any screen size.
faq.q10Q: How much does an online wedding invitation cost?
faq.q10A: You create and try it for free, and pay just once when you're happy and ready to publish.

faq1.question: Can I create a beautiful invitation without design skills?
faq1.answer: Absolutely. Every template is professionally designed. Choose your favorite and enter your information without adjusting layouts, fonts, or colors.

faq2.question: What if I do not have much time?
faq2.answer: Ten minutes is enough to choose a template, add names and dates, and upload a few photos. You can also save a draft and return later.

faq3.question: Is creating an invitation really free?
faq3.answer: Yes. Creating, editing, and previewing are free and require no sign-up. Try every feature for three days and only pay when you are happy.

faq4.question: What should I prepare first?
faq4.answer: Prepare the couple and family names, ceremony and reception details, five to ten favorite photos, and bank details if you want to receive gifts by QR.

faq5.question: How do I share the invitation?
faq5.answer: Send one general link or a personal guest link through Messenger, SMS, email, or any chat app. Guests can open it on phones and computers.

faq6.question: Can guests RSVP on the invitation?
faq6.answer: Yes. Guests respond directly on the invitation, and you can follow every response from your guest dashboard.

faq7.question: How do I pay?
faq7.answer: Open your dashboard and choose payment. Scan the bank QR code or make a manual transfer, and the invitation is activated automatically.

faq8.question: Can I keep editing after payment?
faq8.answer: Yes. Change the template, photos, names, schedule, or music at any time. The original shared link updates automatically.
